predictions.selection_reason: User-controlled data object -> checks if option is 'root' -> prevents include directory manipulation that could lead to RCE
predictions.source_summary: User-provided data object passed to render/renderFile functions, which may contain option properties including 'root'
predictions.sink_summary: File system operations via getIncludePath -> resolveInclude -> path.resolve, used for EJS template includes
predictions.guard_summary: New guard prevents 'root' option from being copied from user data to internal options, blocking path traversal via root manipulation
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled root option could enable directory traversal in EJS include resolution, allowing arbitrary file inclusion
predictions.context_summary: The cpOptsInData function copies option properties from user data to internal options for compatibility. The 'root' option controls the base directory for EJS include resolution. Without the guard, user-controlled root could enable path traversal attacks.
unresolved_facts: Specific attack vectors that could exploit root manipulation
Whether other options in _OPTS could also be security-sensitive

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Improper input validation of root directory path leading to path traversal in template engine
retrieval_query.missing_control: validation of root option from untrusted data
retrieval_query.impact: arbitrary file inclusion, template injection, code execution
